I’m very disappointed with the service. They gave my cat a horrible haircut. I never asked for him to be shaved or made to look bald. The result was completely different from what I expected and looked very unprofessional.
They also charged me the full price despite the poor service. I definitely would not recommend this place to anyone looking for a good grooming service for their cat.

They gave my cat a terrible haircut and made him look ugly. This was extremely unprofessional. I never asked them to shave him or make him look bald, yet that’s exactly what they did. On top of that they charged me the full price.

My long-haired dog has been going to Pawz R Us for years, and she consistently delivers excellent work. The coat always comes out healthy, well-maintained, and beautifully groomed.

What really stands out is how clean and organized the facility is—you can tell they take hygiene seriously. Olga and her team are genuinely patient and understanding with the dogs, especially important for a grooming visit where animals can get nervous. They take their time, handle each dog with care, and you can see they actually enjoy what they do.

The work is reliable every single time. My dog always comes out looking great and clearly comfortable with the experience, which says everything about how they operate. If you have a long-haired dog or any pet that needs quality grooming, Pawz R Us is worth the visit. Hats off to Olga and the team. 💈🐺 💙
Fast, precise, professional work; the receptionist and the hairdresser are friendly, attentive, and helpful.
We love this place! Very customer friendly! We are customers for 3 years, had never been disappointed with service. Highly recommend

The best and most gentle grooming services ever. I love that there is a glass window to watch your pet the entire time if you decide to stay. I feel that this eases the more nervous dog's and cats when they can see their human. The grooming is always impeccable! We pay around $100 for our small dog but I promise you that it is well worth every dollar. The place is like an upscale spa for animals.

The place is very nice and the people are lovely . Definitely recommend.

I want to share a heartfelt review of this wonderful grooming salon, and especially of our amazing groomer, Olga! ❤️

For the past 3.5 years, we have trusted Olga with our Cookie, and every single time she turns him into an absolute little treat! 🍬🐶 She doesn’t just give him a beautiful haircut — she truly understands him, treats him with love and care, and always pays attention to every little detail.

Over the years, Olga has become someone we completely trust. I always know that Cookie is in good hands, and that he will come home looking absolutely perfect. You can tell that Olga genuinely loves animals and puts her heart into what she does.

Thank you, Olga, for your incredible talent, patience, kindness, and for always making our Cookie look like the cutest little gentleman! ✨🐾

If you’re looking for a groomer who truly cares about your pet, I highly recommend Olga. We found our perfect groomer 3.5 years ago, and we wouldn’t want anyone else! ❤️

I rarely leave bad reviews, but damn this was by far the worst grooming experience I’ve had. We paid $160 for our cat to be groomed, and the haircut looks rushed and unfinished. They even asked if we wanted him bathed, what exactly are we paying $160 for? To make matters worse, they called for him to be picked up, but when my dad arrived, they hadn’t even bathed him yet.

I wasn’t there personally, but if I had been, I would have taken him elsewhere immediately. I was so concerned about how he was being handled after how they treated my parents that I had to call and ask them to please take good care of my cat because he’s 18yrs old. The entire service felt half-

10/31 - I took my 10-month-old poodle, Theo, to Iana for grooming, and I can’t say enough good things about her. From the moment we walked in, she was so kind and patient. You can instantly tell she truly loves what she does and cares deeply about the dogs she works with.

She didn’t rush a thing, and when I picked him up, he looked absolutely perfect - fluffy, clean, and so happy! It honestly melted my heart to see how calm and content he was after his appointment.

If I could leave 0 stars, I would. I am currently writing this with tears in my eyes and my hands shaking. My dog was given to me with a bleeding paw and his tail was cut extremely uneven. At first the place was not picking up the phone, then I was told that there was no bleeding when he was returned to me… then they started saying that the nails weren’t cut short and he had minor bleeding that they put a paste on… great storytelling. Upon my return home, I have a bloody floor, my carpet is stained in blood, my dog is shaking and refuses to even take treats. I never imagined such carelessness towards an innocent animal, especially from a business that is supposed to love animals.

Update: I spoke to the owner and the conversation was nothing other than pleasant. This place has wonderful groomers and I’ve been beyond happy with the services before, this was just an unfortunate situation.

Thank you Sesilia,
You are absolutely amazing and did a fantastic job with my baby Gucci 🥰🥰 He Looks Fabulous 😍

We have been regular clients of this grooming salon for a long time and generally had only good experiences in the past.
During our most recent visit we had an unpleasant situation with a groomer named Ronald. There were concerns about how our dog’s nails were trimmed and how his paws were handled, which caused stress for our dog and worried us as owners.
After we raised our concerns, the owner Yulia  personally contacted us and took the situation seriously. She sincerely apologized for what happened, explained the details, and assured us that she does not tolerate any mistreatment of animals. She also said she would speak with the groomer to prevent similar situations with other doggies.😉
We appreciate the owner’s professionalism and willingness to address the issue directly. While the situation itself was stressful, it was handled responsibly by management, and that means a lot to us as pet owners!

I brought my dog in for a regular grooming (wash with a trim around the eyes and sanitary areas, no full haircut). They took their time with the wash, which I actually appreciated—you can tell they’re thorough and detail-oriented. I was able to watch from the waiting area, which made me feel even more comfortable with the care he was getting. They cleaned all the buildup from his face and fur, trimmed neatly where needed, and didn’t rush the process. He came out extremely fluffy, smelled amazing (literally like Christmas), and looked so cute. You can tell they really care about doing a good job.

2 days ago we brought our cat to this office with a simple request: to bathe him and lightly trim the ends of his fur to give it some shape. We never asked for — or even discussed — any radical shaving.

We paid $150 for this service. And what we received for that money is hard to even call a service.

When we picked up our cat, we were absolutely shocked.
Instead of gentle grooming, they returned our pet completely shaved — his body was cut down to the skin, with only the head, paws, and tail left untouched. You can see in the photos the condition he was in: scared, trembling, with huge frightened eyes. He was clearly uncomfortable and distressed.

The staff apologized, but mistakes like this should never happen for $150. This was not a misunderstanding — it was gross unprofessionalism and a complete disregard for what the client actually requested.

We paid a significant amount for a simple bath and a small trim — and we ended up with a terrified cat stripped of all the fur on his body.

I absolutely do not recommend this place.
If you value your pet and your money, stay far away. I wouldn’t wish this experience on anyone — not for their pet and not for their family.
